method: Expanded browser review of 11 tracked Reddit discussions, including older comments and nested replies
coverage: Expanded browser review loaded 304 accessible comment entries of 325 displayed across 11 tracked threads. All visible older-comment and nested-reply controls were expanded; 21 displayed comments remained inaccessible. Reviewed current and historical location text, with selected full-size image checks; not every image was reopened. No broader Reddit-wide completeness claim.
